summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K on June 15, 2026, announcing the appointment of Hilde Garssen as chief human resources officer and member of the Management Board Banking, effective September 1, 2026. She will succeed Ruth McGill, who left in November 2025, and replaces interim CHRO Isaac Vitini. The appointment, approved by the European Central Bank, is a routine board-level change with no abrupt departure, forced exit, or event-driven significance. No deal terms, financial structures, or strategic shifts are present. This filing is a standard personnel update, not a special situation meriting a distinct category beyond 'Management Changes' with low confidence.
